item.title: Bus Fare Cap Pilot Set to Bring £2 Journeys Across The Highlands and Islands
item.description: A £2 bus fare cap pilot covering the Highlands, Moray, Argyll and island communities will launch in 2026 after Bus Users UK helped shape the scheme, aiming to cut travel costs, boost passenger numbers, and protect vital bus services across rural Scotland.The post Bus Fare Cap Pilot Set to Bring £2 Journeys Across The Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: The High Life Cleared for Take Off as Cult BBC Comedy Becomes a Scottish Stage Musical
item.description: The cult BBC comedy The High Life is returning as a new stage musical in 2026, reuniting its original cast and touring Scotland, with performances at Eden Court Inverness from 29 April to 2 May, bringing Air Scotia back to life for a new generation.The post The High Life Cleared for Take Off as Cult BBC Comedy Becomes a Scottish Stage Musical appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NFU Scotland Urges Funding Clarity for Sea Eagle Scheme Ahead of 2026 Lambing
item.description: NFU Scotland is urging the Scottish Government to confirm funding for the Sea Eagle Management Scheme ahead of 2026 lambing, warning that continued uncertainty risks animal welfare, farm viability and confidence among hill farmers and crofters across upland Scotland.The post NFU Scotland Urges Funding Clarity for Sea Eagle Scheme Ahead of 2026 Lambing appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Call for Block on Labour Lords Appointment Linked to Scandal
item.description: The SNP is calling for Keir Starmer’s proposed House of Lords appointment of Matthew Doyle to be blocked, warning the nomination risks further damage to public trust following controversy over links to a convicted sex offender and raising fresh questions about political accountability.The post SNP Call for Block on Labour Lords Appointment Linked to Scandal appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Snow and Ice Warning as Highlands Face Cold Start to The New Year
item.description: Snow and ice warnings have been issued as the Highlands face a cold start to the New Year, with Arctic air, strong northerly winds and snowfall expected to bring frosts and travel disruption across northern Scotland into early January.The post Snow and Ice Warning as Highlands Face Cold Start to The New Year appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: 40mph Speed Limit to Begin on A9 as Dualling Works Step Up Near Ballinluig
item.description: A temporary 40mph speed limit will be introduced on the A9 between Jubilee Bridge and Ballinluig from 5 January 2026 as dualling works step up, with drivers urged to plan ahead as traffic management remains in place until 2028.The post 40mph Speed Limit to Begin on A9 as Dualling Works Step Up Near Ballinluig appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Year of Grit, Growth and Getting The Job Done for M&H Carriers
item.description: Highland logistics firm M&H Carriers is reflecting on a year of growth, pressure and record demand, with expanding operations across Scotland, award winning workplace culture and a continued focus on the people keeping goods moving as the business looks ahead to 2026.The post A Year of Grit, Growth and Getting The Job Done for M&H Carriers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Loganair Launches Tartan Sale With 17% Off Flights for 2026 Travel
item.description: Loganair has launched its Tartan Sale, offering 17% off flights across its UK network for 2026 travel, giving Highland and island travellers the chance to book early, secure value fares and plan ahead for spring breaks and essential journeys.The post Loganair Launches Tartan Sale With 17% Off Flights for 2026 Travel appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Warns Sarwar’s Nuclear Backing Risks Scotland’s Energy Future
item.description: The SNP has accused Anas Sarwar of backing nuclear power projects that could cost Scottish households hundreds of millions of pounds, warning that spiralling costs at Sizewell C risk undermining Scotland’s renewables future and driving up energy bills.The post SNP Warns Sarwar’s Nuclear Backing Risks Scotland’s Energy Future appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: The Haven Centre Reflects on a Heartfelt Year of Leadership, Growth and Life-Changing Family Support
item.description: Highland charity The Haven Centre is reflecting on a year of new leadership, growing community impact and life changing support for families with complex needs, as it looks ahead to 2026 with plans to reach more families and expand opportunities for young people across the Highlands.The post The Haven Centre Reflects on a Heartfelt Year of Leadership, Growth and Life-Changing Family Support appeared first on The Highland Times.
